title: Palindrome Number Checker
description: Check whether a given number reads the same forwards and backwards.
code:
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
original = num
reversed_num = 0

while num > 0:
    digit = num % 10
    reversed_num = reversed_num * 10 + digit
    num //= 10

if original == reversed_num:
    print(original, "is a palindrome")
else:
    print(original, "is not a palindrome")
expectedOutput: Enter a number: 1221 is a palindrome
